name: MẠCH SỐ — Video Design System
style: Swiss Editorial × Technology Magazine × Data Journalism
colorRules: A typical graphic frame should be mostly paper (#FAFAF7) or white (#FFFFFF).
Use signal-blue (#3157A4) for the primary highlighted concept; signal-orange (#E27B50) for turning point or warning.
Keep body text in ink (#222222); use muted-ink (#6B6B68) only for secondary information.
Do not use neon cyan, electric purple, rainbow gradients, or glowing synthetic circuit boards.
